engine._autostart_mode_note: Retained for schema compatibility and ignored: boot is always Paper. Setting it to 'live' does nothing. Live is an operator action taken at the dashboard against a running process, so that neither a redeploy nor a crash-restart can put an unattended box into Live.

_strategy_note: 'directional' is the lead/lag model with the measured entry cap - see entry.max_entries_per_window. 'maker' quotes both sides for sub-$1 pairs (structurally sound but its paper P/L so far is one lottery hit, not an edge). 'both' runs both.

bankroll._note: Operator-declared $150 bankroll. These limits are mandatory in both Paper and Live, including override modes: keep $90 uncommitted, risk no more than $25 in one timed interval, stop after $15 net settled loss in a UTC day, and turn over no more than $300 per UTC day.

live_market_selection._note: Disabled by operator choice: Live may trade every asset/window that Paper may trade. Historical paper rankings remain visible for comparison only.

maker._rewards_note: Liquidity rewards were investigated and RULED OUT for these markets: Gamma reports rewardsMaxSpread/rewardsMinSize, but the venue reward register (8960 markets, 18 pages) contains none of the short crypto windows. No reward income is modelled. target_rewards is retained only to size quotes larger; it earns nothing.
maker._drift_note: Cancel and re-quote once mid has moved this far from our resting price. Stale quotes are the main source of adverse selection.

sizing._daily_cap_note: Paper and Live use the same $300 UTC-day turnover ceiling for the $150 bankroll. The separate mandatory bankroll controls also cap simultaneous exposure and stop on daily loss, even when profit-tuned override is active.

entry._profit_tuned_note: Live 24h review: the confidence-only cohort returned 11.2% ROI. Keeping signals at or above 70% confidence, at 79c or less, and in the first half of the window replayed at 41.5% ROI while reducing worst-window loss from $69.94 to $14.96. Other bot limits remain bypassed except operator market exclusions, the confirmed opposite-side switch gate, and the mandatory $150-bankroll controls: $25 per shared timed interval, $60 total open exposure, $15 daily loss stop, and $300 daily turnover. Exchange availability, balance/allowance, minimum order, and fillability still apply.
entry._entry_cap_note: At most two same-window entries remain allowed. This preserves the pre-change effective cap after disabling the reserved reversal slot and prevents the failed reversal experiment from silently creating a third ordinary entry.
entry._evidence_gate_note: When enabled by operator limits, every new Paper or Live entry must still belong to a Paper cohort with at least 100 settlements and positive fee-adjusted ROI in both the latest 50 and preceding 50. This prevents a stale allowlist from continuing to trade a degraded cohort.
entry._experimental_market_note: Optional exact Paper-only forward-test cohorts may bypass the rolling evidence gate only when their configured minimum confidence meets paper_experimental_min_confidence (90% by default). They remain blocked in Live until normally evidence-qualified.
entry._price_band_note: Reviewed LIVE entries at 80-89c returned -3.9% and 90c+ returned -0.8%; profit-tuned mode therefore caps the worst execution price at 79c while leaving cheap high-confidence entries eligible.
entry._reversal_note: Opposite-side entries remain implemented but are disabled because settled reversal windows failed the 100-window, two-block evidence gate. Re-enable only for a new controlled Paper forward test; Live reversal stays disabled until its own Paper cohort qualifies.

depth_guard._comment: Roughly 10x the base clip. The upstream repo's 250 assumed far larger sizing and would exclude most of this venue's short-window books.

_fees_note: Read from the live CLOB V2 market feeSchedule: fee = shares * rate * (price * (1-price)) ^ exponent, TAKERS ONLY. Makers pay nothing. At 50c and rate 0.07 this is 1.75c/share (3.5% of notional).
